-- Draft tables + procedures (Lift/Escalator Periodic Renewal - address wise upload)
CREATE TABLE dbo.tbl_LiftRenewalDraft(
    Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    RegistrationNo NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    InstallationType NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    LastPaymentDate DATETIME NULL,
    CreatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_LiftRenewalDraft UNIQUE (CreatedBy, RegistrationNo, InstallationType)
);
GO
CREATE TABLE dbo.tbl_LiftRenewalDraftDocs(
    Id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    DraftId INT NOT NULL REFERENCES dbo.tbl_LiftRenewalDraft(Id),
    DocumentID INT NOT NULL,
    DocumentName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    FileName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    DocumentPath NVARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    CreatedDate DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE()
);
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_GetLiftRenewalDrafts @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT D.RegistrationNo, D.InstallationType, D.LastPaymentDate,
           DD.DocumentID, DD.DocumentName, DD.FileName, DD.DocumentPath
    FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraft D
    LEFT JOIN tbl_LiftRenewalDraftDocs DD ON DD.DraftId = D.Id
    WHERE D.CreatedBy = @CreatedBy;
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_SaveLiftRenewalDraft
    @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50), @RegistrationNo NVARCHAR(100), @InstallationType NVARCHAR(50),
    @LastPaymentDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @DocumentID INT = NULL, @DocumentName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
    @FileName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL, @DocumentPath NVARCHAR(500) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DraftId INT;
    SELECT @DraftId = Id FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraft
    WHERE CreatedBy = @CreatedBy AND RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo AND InstallationType = @InstallationType;

    IF @DraftId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO tbl_LiftRenewalDraft (CreatedBy, RegistrationNo, InstallationType, LastPaymentDate)
        VALUES (@CreatedBy, @RegistrationNo, @InstallationType, @LastPaymentDate);
        SET @DraftId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END
    ELSE IF @LastPaymentDate IS NOT NULL
        UPDATE tbl_LiftRenewalDraft SET LastPaymentDate = @LastPaymentDate WHERE Id = @DraftId;

    IF @DocumentID IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraftDocs WHERE DraftId = @DraftId AND DocumentID = @DocumentID;
        INSERT INTO tbl_LiftRenewalDraftDocs (DraftId, DocumentID, DocumentName, FileName, DocumentPath)
        VALUES (@DraftId, @DocumentID, @DocumentName, @FileName, @DocumentPath);
    END
END
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_DeleteLiftRenewalDraft
    @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50), @RegistrationNo NVARCHAR(100), @InstallationType NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DraftId INT;
    SELECT @DraftId = Id FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraft
    WHERE CreatedBy = @CreatedBy AND RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo AND InstallationType = @InstallationType;
    IF @DraftId IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraftDocs WHERE DraftId = @DraftId;
        DELETE FROM tbl_LiftRenewalDraft WHERE Id = @DraftId;
    END
END
GO

-- 1) NAYI procedure: latest (CreatedDate ke hisaab se) pending record ka ApplicantDistrict
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetLatestLiftRenewalDistrict]
(
    @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (1) ApplicantDistrict
    FROM tbl_LiftRenewal
    WHERE CreatedBy = @CreatedBy
      AND Status = 1
      AND InspectionID IS NULL
      AND ApplicantDistrict IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC, ID DESC;
END
GO

-- 2) Purani procedure me sirf LR.SiteAddress column add kiya hai (baaki sab same)
ALTER procedure [dbo].[Sp_GetLiftRenewaldata]
(
@ApplicantDistrict nvarchar(50)  = NULL,
@CreatedBy	nvarchar(50)
)
AS
Begin
select
LR.TestReportID as TestReportID, LR.InstallationType  [InstallationType], LR.RegistrationNo [RegistrationNo], CONVERT(VARCHAR, LR.LastExpiryDate, 103) AS [LastExpiryDate],
CONVERT(VARCHAR, LR.LastApprovalDate, 103) AS LastApprovalDate,
COALESCE
    ( (  SELECT TOP (1) A.Current_ChallanDate FROM tbl_liftApproval_Inspections A  WHERE A.RegistrationNo = LR.RegistrationNo  ORDER BY A.CreatedDate DESC ),
   ( SELECT TOP (1) LR2.LastDateOfPayment  FROM tbl_LiftRenewal LR2  WHERE LR2.RegistrationNo = LR.RegistrationNo  AND LR2.Status = 1 AND LR.APPLICATIONSTATUS = 'Approved' ORDER BY LR2.ID DESC )
    ) AS LastPaymentDate,
LR.PreviousChallanUpload [PreviousChallanUpload], LR.Make [Make], LR.SerialNo [SerialNo], LR.TypeOfLift [TypeOfLift],
LR.TypeOfControl [TypeOfControl], LR.ApplicantDistrict [ApplicantDistrict], LR.Capacity [Capacity], LR.Weight as [Weight], LR.CreatedBy [CreatedBy], 'Periodic' as TypeOfInstallation, LR.Amount [Amount],
LR.SiteAddress [SiteAddress]
from tbl_LiftRenewal LR
where LR.CreatedBy=@CreatedBy 
AND (@ApplicantDistrict IS NULL OR LR.ApplicantDistrict = @ApplicantDistrict)
AND LR.Status = 1 AND LR.InspectionID is Null 
ORDER BY LR.SiteAddress, LR.InstallationType, LR.RegistrationNo
End
GO


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_GetLiftEscalatorExpiringList]
(
    @PANNumber NVARCHAR(50),
    @ExpiringInMonths INT = 1,
    @Type NVARCHAR(50) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH LiftEscalatorCTE AS
    (
        SELECT
            LAI.RegistrationNo,
            MAX(LAI.ExpiryDate) AS ExpiryDate
        FROM tbl_liftApproval_Inspections LAI
        INNER JOIN tbl_Inspection I
            ON I.Id = LAI.InspectionId
        WHERE I.CreatedBy = @PANNumber
          AND I.ApplicationStatus = 'Approved'
          AND LAI.Status = 1
          AND LAI.RegistrationNo IS NOT NULL
          AND (@Type IS NULL OR LAI.InstallationType = @Type)
        GROUP BY LAI.RegistrationNo
    ),
    LatestInspectionCTE AS
    (
        SELECT
            LAT.RegistrationNo,
            LAT.Make,
            LAT.LiftSrNo,
            LAT.TypeOfControl,
            LAT.Capacity,
            LAT.[Weight],
            LAT.Lift_Escelator_Id,
            LAT.TypeOfLift,
            LAT.InstallationType,
            LAT.ExpiryDate AS RecordExpiryDate,
            LAT.Status,
            LAT.InspectionType,
            LAT.ErectionDate,
            LAT.Division,
            LAT.District,
            LAT.SiteAddress,
            LAT.CreatedDate AS LastApprovalDate,
            LAT.Current_ChallanDate,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY LAT.RegistrationNo
                ORDER BY LAT.CreatedDate DESC, LAT.InspectionID DESC
            ) AS RN

        FROM tbl_liftApproval_Inspections LAT
        INNER JOIN tbl_Inspection I
            ON I.ID = LAT.InspectionID
        WHERE I.CreatedBy = @PANNumber
          AND I.ApplicationStatus = 'Approved'
          AND LAT.Status = 1
          AND LAT.RegistrationNo IS NOT NULL
          AND (@Type IS NULL OR LAT.InstallationType = @Type)
    )
    SELECT
        L.RegistrationNo,
        L.Make,
        L.LiftSrNo,
        L.TypeOfControl,
        L.Capacity,
        L.[Weight],
        L.Lift_Escelator_Id,
        L.TypeOfLift,
        L.InstallationType,
        L.RecordExpiryDate AS ExpiryDate,
        L.Status,
        L.InspectionType,
        L.ErectionDate,
        L.Division,
        L.District,
        L.SiteAddress,
        L.LastApprovalDate,
        L.Current_ChallanDate
    FROM LatestInspectionCTE L
    INNER JOIN LiftEscalatorCTE E
        ON E.RegistrationNo = L.RegistrationNo
    WHERE L.RN = 1
      AND E.ExpiryDate <= DATEADD
      (
          MONTH,
          @ExpiringInMonths,
          CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
      )
	-- New renewal request hone par list se remove karega
	  AND NOT EXISTS
	  (
		  SELECT 1
		  FROM dbo.tbl_LiftRenewal LR
		  WHERE LR.RegistrationNo = L.RegistrationNo
			AND LR.CreatedBy = @PANNumber
			AND LR.Status = 1
			AND LR.CreatedDate > L.LastApprovalDate
			AND LR.ApplicationStatus <> 'REJECTED'
			AND NOT EXISTS
			(
				SELECT 1
				FROM dbo.tbl_liftApproval_Inspections LAI
				WHERE LAI.RegistrationNo = LR.RegistrationNo
				  AND LAI.CreatedBy = LR.CreatedBy
				  AND LAI.Status = 1
				  AND LAI.CreatedDate > L.LastApprovalDate
			)
	  )

	ORDER BY E.ExpiryDate;
END
GO


ALTER Procedure [dbo].[sp_GetDocumentsForLiftRenewal]        
(          
 @ApplicantType nvarchar(255),          
 @InstallationTypeID int,          
 @InspectionType nvarchar(255),
 @InstallationType nvarchar(255)
)          
  As          
  Begin
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT 1 )) AS SNo, DocumentID, DocumentName, DocumentShortName, Req
  From
  (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.DocumentID, a.DocumentName,          
  REPLACE(a.DocumentShortName, '_', '') DocumentShortName,          
  CASE WHEN a.DocumentID IN ( 14 ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Req         
  FROM tbl_DocumentMaster AS a          
  INNER JOIN tbl_DocumentCheckListMaster AS b ON a.DocumentID = b.DocumentID          
  WHERE b.ApplicantTypeCode = @ApplicantType       
  AND b.InstallationTypeID = @InstallationTypeID         
  AND b.InspectionType = @InspectionType     
  AND b.InstallationType = @InstallationType     
  AND a.Status = 1) as T Order By DocumentShortName
  End
  
GO


--exec sp_GetPeriodicRenewalData 'Lift','C50291L15','ABSCS2229P' 
ALTER procedure [dbo].[sp_GetPeriodicRenewalData]
(
@Type nvarchar(50),
@RegistrationNo nvarchar(50),
@CreatedBy nvarchar(50)
)
As
Begin

SELECT  Top(1) 
       LAT.Make,LAT.LiftSrNo,LAT.TypeOfControl,LAT.Capacity,
	   --LAT.[Weight],
	   --Changed On 17 July because weight stored null TEC-00047 to resolve this 
	   CASE 
    WHEN (LAT.[Weight] IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(LAT.[Weight] AS NVARCHAR(50)))) = '')
         AND TRY_CAST(LAT.Capacity AS DECIMAL(18,2)) <= 15
    THEN TRY_CAST(LAT.Capacity AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 68
    ELSE LAT.[Weight]
END AS [Weight],
	   
	   
	   LAT.Lift_Escelator_Id,LAT.TypeOfLift,
       LAT.InstallationType,LAT.RegistrationNo,
	   LAT.ExpiryDate ,
	   LAT.Status,LAT.InspectionType,
	   LAT.ErectionDate AS ErectionDate,
	   LAT.Division,LAT.District,LAT.SiteAddress,LAT.Amount,
	   (Select Top(1) Current_ChallanDate From  tbl_liftApproval_Inspections
        Where  RegistrationNo=LAT.RegistrationNo ) 
		 AS LastTransactionDate,
		 --LAT.Current_ChallanDate as LastPaymentDate, 
		COALESCE(
	   LAT.Current_ChallanDate ,(SELECT TOP 1 LR.LastDateOfPayment FROM tbl_Liftrenewal LR WHERE LR.RegistrationNo = LAT.RegistrationNo  AND LR.Status = '1' AND LR.APPLICATIONSTATUS = 'Approved'  ORDER BY LR.ID DESC))  as LastPaymentDate,
	   LAT.CreatedDate AS LastApprovalDate,   
	   LAT.MemoDate,LAT.MemoNo
	   From tbl_liftApproval_Inspections AS LAT
	   LEFT JOIN tbl_Inspection AS I ON I.ID = LAT.InspectionID
Where  LAT.RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo 
AND LAT.InstallationType=@Type 
AND Status='1'
AND I.CreatedBy=@CreatedBy
ORDER BY LAT.CreatedDate DESC
End

GO

ALTER Procedure [dbo].[sp_InsertPeriodicLiftData]
(
    @InstallationType       nvarchar(50),
    @RegistrationNo         nvarchar(100),
    @LastExpiryDate         datetime,
    @PreviousChallanUpload  nvarchar(200),
    @lastDateOfPayment       datetime = NULL,
    @ErectionDate           datetime,
    @Make                   nvarchar(150),
    @SerialNo               nvarchar(100),
    @TypeOfLift             nvarchar(100),
    @TypeOfControl          nvarchar(50),
    @Capacity               nvarchar(100),
    @Weight                 decimal(18, 2),
    @ApplicantDistrict      nvarchar(50),
    @MemoNo                 nvarchar(200),
    @MemoDate               datetime,
    @SiteAddress            nvarchar(255),
    @CreatedBy              nvarchar(50),
    @GeneratedTestReportID  varchar(50) OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @TReportID NVARCHAR(50);
    SET @TReportID = 'PTL-' + RIGHT('00000' + CAST(ISNULL((SELECT MAX(CONVERT(BIGINT, ID)) FROM tbl_LiftRenewal), 0) + 1 AS NVARCHAR(50)), 5);

	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_LiftRenewal WHERE RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo AND Status = 1 AND ApplicationStatus = 'Pending')
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Your request with RegistrationNo is already in "Pending" status.', 16, 1, @RegistrationNo);
        RETURN;
    END
	
	DECLARE @RenewalDate DATETIME;
	DECLARE @FirstExpiryDate DATETIME;
	DECLARE @Amount decimal(18,2);

Set @RenewalDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @LastExpiryDate));
Set @FirstExpiryDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @MemoDate));

	if @lastDateOfPayment = Null or @lastDateOfPayment=''
	Begin
	Set @lastDateOfPayment = null;
		SET @Amount = 1000.00;
	end
	else
	Begin

	DECLARE @YearsDifference INT;
	DECLARE @MonthsDifference INT;
	DECLARE @DaysDifference INT;
	DECLARE @ToCalculateDifference DATETIME;


SELECT @ToCalculateDifference = DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, @lastDateOfPayment, GETDATE()), @lastDateOfPayment)
SELECT @YearsDifference = DATEDIFF(year, @lastDateOfPayment, GETDATE()) - (CASE WHEN @ToCalculateDifference > GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

SELECT @MonthsDifference = MONTH(GETDATE() - @ToCalculateDifference) - 1

IF (@YearsDifference > 2)
Begin
    SET @Amount = 1000.00;
End
ELSE If(@YearsDifference = 2)
Begin
	If(@MonthsDifference >= 11)
	Begin
		SET @Amount = 1000.00;
	End
	Else
	Begin
		SET @Amount = 0.00;
	End
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SET @Amount = 0.00;
END
end
	INSERT INTO tbl_LiftRenewal 
				(
					TestReportID,
					InstallationType,
					RegistrationNo,
					LastExpiryDate,
					PreviousChallanUpload,
					lastDateOfPayment,
					ErectionDate,
					Make,
					SerialNo,
					TypeOfLift,
					TypeOfControl,
					Capacity,
					Weight,
					ApplicantDistrict,
					MemoNo,
					MemoDate,
					SiteAddress,
					CreatedDate,
					CreatedBy,
					Status,
					ApplicationStatus,
					Amount,
					RenewalDate,
					FirstExpiryDate
				)   
			VALUES
				(
					@TReportID,
					@InstallationType,
					@RegistrationNo,
					@LastExpiryDate,
					@PreviousChallanUpload,
					@lastDateOfPayment,
					@ErectionDate,
					@Make,
					@SerialNo,
					@TypeOfLift,
					@TypeOfControl,
					@Capacity,
					@Weight,
					@ApplicantDistrict,
					@MemoNo,
					@MemoDate,
					@SiteAddress,
					GETDATE(),
					@CreatedBy,
					'1',
					'Pending',
					@Amount,
					@RenewalDate,
					@FirstExpiryDate
				);   
				
				SET @GeneratedTestReportID = @TReportID;
	END




	go

	
GO

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertPeriodicReturnData]
    (
      @TestReportId NVARCHAR(50) ,
      @InstallationType NVARCHAR(50) ,
      @RegistrationNo NVARCHAR(100) ,
      @LastExpiryDate DATETIME ,
      @PreviousChallanUpload NVARCHAR(200) ,
      @lastDateOfPayment DATETIME = NULL ,
      @ErectionDate DATETIME ,
      @Make NVARCHAR(150) ,
      @SerialNo NVARCHAR(100) ,
      @TypeOfLift NVARCHAR(100) ,
      @TypeOfControl NVARCHAR(50) ,
      @Capacity NVARCHAR(100) ,
      @Weight DECIMAL(18, 2) ,
      @ApplicantDistrict NVARCHAR(50) ,
      @MemoNo NVARCHAR(200) ,
      @MemoDate DATETIME ,
      @SiteAddress NVARCHAR(255) ,
      @InspectionId INT ,
      @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50)
    )
AS 
    BEGIN

        DECLARE @TReportID NVARCHAR(50) ;
        SET @TReportID = 'PTL-' + RIGHT('00000'
                                        + CAST(ISNULL(( SELECT
                                                              MAX(CONVERT(BIGINT, ID))
                                                        FROM  tbl_LiftRenewal
                                                      ), 0) + 1 AS NVARCHAR(50)),
                                        5) ;


        UPDATE  [tbl_LiftRenewal]
        SET     [Status] = 0
        WHERE   [TestReportID] = @TestReportID ;

	
        DECLARE @RenewalDate DATETIME ;
        DECLARE @FirstExpiryDate DATETIME ;
        DECLARE @Amount DECIMAL(18, 2) ;

        SET @RenewalDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @LastExpiryDate)) ;
        SET @FirstExpiryDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @MemoDate)) ;

        IF @lastDateOfPayment = NULL
            OR @lastDateOfPayment = '' 
            BEGIN
                SET @lastDateOfPayment = NULL ;
                SET @Amount = 1000.00 ;
            END
        ELSE 
            BEGIN

                DECLARE @YearsDifference INT ;
                DECLARE @MonthsDifference INT ;
                DECLARE @DaysDifference INT ;
                DECLARE @ToCalculateDifference DATETIME ;

--Changed On 13 mar 2026 To find payment requirement Calculation condition
                --SELECT  @ToCalculateDifference = DATEADD(year,
                --                                         DATEDIFF(year,
                --                                              @RenewalDate,
                --                                              GETDATE()),
                --                                         @RenewalDate)
                --SELECT  @YearsDifference = DATEDIFF(year, @RenewalDate,
                --                                    GETDATE())
                --        - ( CASE WHEN @ToCalculateDifference > GETDATE()
                --                 THEN 1
                --                 ELSE 0
                --            END )

                SELECT  @ToCalculateDifference = DATEADD(year,
                                                         DATEDIFF(year,
                                                              @lastDateOfPayment,
                                                              GETDATE()),
                                                         @lastDateOfPayment)
                SELECT  @YearsDifference = DATEDIFF(year, @lastDateOfPayment,
                                                    GETDATE())
                        - ( CASE WHEN @ToCalculateDifference > GETDATE()
                                 THEN 1
                                 ELSE 0
                            END )


                SELECT  @MonthsDifference = MONTH(GETDATE()
                                                  - @ToCalculateDifference)
                        - 1

                IF ( @YearsDifference > 2 ) 
                    BEGIN
                        SET @Amount = 1000.00 ;
                    END
                ELSE 
                    IF ( @YearsDifference = 2 ) 
                        BEGIN
                            IF ( @MonthsDifference >= 11 ) 
                                BEGIN
                                    SET @Amount = 1000.00 ;
                                END
                            ELSE 
                                BEGIN
                                    SET @Amount = 0.00 ;
                                END
                        END
                    ELSE 
                        BEGIN
                            SET @Amount = 0.00 ;
                        END
            END
-- Insert a new record with Status = 1
        INSERT  INTO tbl_LiftRenewal
                ( TestReportID ,
                  InstallationType ,
                  RegistrationNo ,
                  LastExpiryDate ,
                  PreviousChallanUpload ,
                  lastDateOfPayment ,
                  ErectionDate ,
                  Make ,
                  SerialNo ,
                  TypeOfLift ,
                  TypeOfControl ,
                  Capacity ,
                  Weight ,
                  ApplicantDistrict ,
                  MemoNo ,
                  MemoDate ,
                  SiteAddress ,
                  CreatedDate ,
                  CreatedBy ,
                  ModifiedBy ,
                  ModifiedDate ,
                  InspectionID ,
                  Status ,
                  ApplicationStatus ,
                  OldTestReportId ,
                  Amount ,
                  RenewalDate ,
                  FirstExpiryDate
                )
        VALUES  ( @TReportID ,
                  @InstallationType ,
                  @RegistrationNo ,
                  @LastExpiryDate ,
                  @PreviousChallanUpload ,
                  @lastDateOfPayment ,
                  @ErectionDate ,
                  @Make ,
                  @SerialNo ,
                  @TypeOfLift ,
                  @TypeOfControl ,
                  @Capacity ,
                  @Weight ,
                  @ApplicantDistrict ,
                  @MemoNo ,
                  @MemoDate ,
                  @SiteAddress ,
                  GETDATE() ,
                  @CreatedBy ,
                  @CreatedBy ,
                  GETDATE() ,
					--Commented on instructions of aslam at 2-Jan-2026--@InspectionId,
                  @InspectionId ,
                  --NULL ,
                  '1' ,
                  'Pending' ,
                  @TestReportId ,
                  @Amount ,
                  @RenewalDate ,
                  @FirstExpiryDate
				
                )   
        SELECT  @TReportID AS TestReportId
    END

go

ALTER  PROCEDURE [dbo].[update_LiftRenewal_PeriodicInspection]              
(              
    --@IntimationId VARCHAR(50),              
    --@Count INT,   
	@RegistrationNo	nvarchar(100),
    @InstallationTypeId INT,                                            
    @CreatedBy VARCHAR(255)              
)              
AS              
BEGIN          
      
    DECLARE @InstallationType VARCHAR(255)              
    SET @InstallationType = (SELECT InstallationType FROM tbl_InstallationType WHERE Id = @InstallationTypeId)              
                 
  IF EXISTS ( SELECT 1   FROM tbl_LiftRenewal   WHERE RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo              
  AND InstallationTypeId = @InstallationTypeId and InspectionId is null )              
  BEGIN            
  Update tbl_LiftRenewal set InspectionStatus = 0, InstallationTypeId =  @InstallationTypeId 
   where RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo and InstallationType =  @InstallationType         
  END               
            
  -- Insert the new record into tbl_PaymentHistory                          
    Update tbl_LiftRenewal set InspectionStatus = 1  ,InstallationTypeId =  @InstallationTypeId	
   where RegistrationNo = @RegistrationNo and InstallationType =  @InstallationType       
                 
END
GO

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_Calculate_InspectionPayment_Amount_LiftEscaltor_Periodic]
(
    @InspectionType VARCHAR(50),
    @InstallationTypeIds VARCHAR(50), 
    @QuantityLift INT= Null, 
    @QuantityEscalator INT= Null ,
	@LiftCountForPayment INT= Null,
	@EscalatorCountForPayment INT= Null
)
AS
BEGIN
  -- Create a table variable to store the split InstallationTypeIDs
    DECLARE @InstallationTypeIdTable TABLE (InstallationTypeID INT);

    INSERT INTO @InstallationTypeIdTable (InstallationTypeID)
    SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
    FROM STRING_SPLIT(@InstallationTypeIds, ',')
    WHERE ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;  -- Ensure the value is numeric before casting

    
    SELECT         
        InstallationType,
       CASE 
            WHEN InstallationType LIKE '%Lift%' AND @LiftCountForPayment > 0 THEN rate * @LiftCountForPayment
            WHEN InstallationType LIKE '%Escalator%' AND @EscalatorCountForPayment > 0 THEN rate * @EscalatorCountForPayment
            ELSE 0  
        END AS TotalAmount,  
        CASE
            WHEN InstallationType LIKE '%Lift%' THEN @QuantityLift
            WHEN InstallationType LIKE '%Escalator%' THEN @QuantityEscalator
            ELSE @QuantityLift  
        END AS Quantity
    FROM Cei_VoltazeLevel_Payment_RateMaster
    WHERE InspectionType = @InspectionType
      AND InstallationTypeID IN (SELECT InstallationTypeID FROM @InstallationTypeIdTable)

END

go

ALTER procedure [dbo].[Sp_GetDivisionByDistrict]
  (
  @AreaCovered nvarchar(150)
  )
  As
  Begin
  Select Distinct Area from tbl_CEIAreaCovered where AreaCovered=@AreaCovered
  End
  go
  ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetStaffIdforPeriodic]
(
  @Division	nvarchar(50),
  @Staff	nvarchar(50),
  @District	nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	if(@Staff='CEI')
		Begin
			Select 'CEI' as StaffUserId
		End
	Else
		Begin
			Select StaffUserID from tbl_CEIAreaCovered 
			Where  Area=@Division AND AreaCovered=@District
			AND Staff=@Staff 
		End
END

go


ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertInspectionDataForPeriodic_LiftInspection]         
(                      
                       
    @ApplicantType NVARCHAR(50) , 
    @InstallationType NVARCHAR(50),                                   
    @District NVARCHAR(50),                
    @Division NVARCHAR(50), 
    @PaymentMode varchar(10),  
    @InspectionRemarks Nvarchar(500),  
    @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(50),           
    @TransactionId NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,        
    @TotalAmount bigint = NULL, 
    @AssignTo NVARCHAR(50), 
    @TransctionDate DATETIME = NULL,                 
    @InspectID int,                    
    @ServiceType int,
    @GeneratedCombinedIdDetails varchar(500) OUTPUT          
) AS       
BEGIN    
    ----------------------------------If Transaction id is mapped With Any Inspectionid(Start) 24 May 2024 ----------------------------------------       
	Declare @Ret_InspectionID int 
	Declare @NextInspectionIdNo int   
	IF ( @InspectID = 0 )         
		Select @NextInspectionIdNo =isnull(max(Id), 1000000) + 1 From tbl_Inspection      
	ELSE        
		SET @NextInspectionIdNo = @InspectID            
	IF EXISTS ( SELECT  'X'  FROM    tbl_Inspection WHERE TransactionId = @TransactionId And ApplicationStatus !='Rejected' )              
		BEGIN                 
			DECLARE @AlreadyInsId INT                 
			SET @AlreadyInsId = ( SELECT  top(1)   Id FROM      tbl_Inspection  WHERE     TransactionId = @TransactionId )      
			IF ( @AlreadyInsId != @NextInspectionIdNo )     
				BEGIN     
					RAISERROR ('Transaction Id Is Already In Use', 16, 1 ) ;      
					RETURN              
				END           
		END      
----------------------------------If Transaction id is mapped With Any Inspectionid(End) ----------------------------------------
Begin Try
Begin Transaction
IF ( @InspectID = 0 )	
Begin
	INSERT  INTO tbl_Inspection( ApplicantType,IntimationId ,InstallationType, ServiceType ,ApplicationStatus ,PaymentMode ,Division ,District ,
	CreatedBy ,CreatedDate ,TransactionId ,TotalAmount ,AssignTo ,TransctionDate ,Active,InspectionCount,
	InspectionRemarks,SystemGenerated,InspectionNewOrExist,TypeOfInspection,Usertype) 	       
	VALUES (@ApplicantType ,'LiftRenewal',@InstallationType ,	7,'Submit' ,@PaymentMode,@Division ,@District,
	@CreatedBy, GETDATE() ,@TransactionId ,@TotalAmount ,@AssignTo ,@TransctionDate ,                 
	'1',1,@InspectionRemarks,'Yes','New','Periodic','NonIndustry')
	 
	SET @Ret_InspectionID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
	
End
--Else
--Begin
--	SET @Ret_InspectionID= @InspectID
--End             
	UPDATE  tbl_LiftRenewal 
	SET 
	InspectionId=@Ret_InspectionID, 
	InspectionCreatedBy=@CreatedBy,
	InspectionCreatedDate=GETDATE()
	WHERE CreatedBy=@CreatedBy AND ApplicantDistrict= @District  AND  InspectionStatus = '1' AND InspectionId is NULL 

	If(@@ERROR=0)
	Begin
	SET @GeneratedCombinedIdDetails = CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @Ret_InspectionID) 
		Commit Transaction
	End
End Try
Begin Catch
	RollBack Transaction
End Catch
End

go

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertInspectionAttachments]
    (
      @InspectionId NVARCHAR(200) ,
      @InstallationType NVARCHAR(100) ,
      @DocumentID INT ,
      @DocSaveName NVARCHAR(200) ,
      @FileName NVARCHAR(200) ,
      @FilePath NVARCHAR(1000) ,
      @CreatedBy NVARCHAR(200)
    )
AS 
    BEGIN    


        IF EXISTS ( SELECT  'x'
                    FROM    tbl_InspectionAttachment
                    WHERE   InspectionId = @InspectionId
                            AND DocumentID = @DocumentID
                            AND InstallationType = @InstallationType
                            AND status = 1 ) 
            BEGIN 
                UPDATE  tbl_InspectionAttachment
                SET     status = 0,
				ModifiedBy = @CreatedBy,
				ModifiedDate = GETDATE()
                WHERE   InspectionId = @InspectionId
                        AND DocumentID = @DocumentID
                        AND InstallationType = @InstallationType
                        AND status = 1

                INSERT  INTO tbl_InspectionAttachment
                        ( InspectionId ,
                          InstallationType ,
                          DocumentID ,
                          DocumentName ,
                          fileName ,
                          DocumentPath ,
                          CreatedDate ,
                          CreatedBy ,
                          Status
                        )
                VALUES  ( @InspectionId ,
                          @InstallationType ,
                          @DocumentID ,
                          @DocSaveName ,
                          @FileName ,
                          @FilePath ,
                          GETDATE() ,
                          @CreatedBy ,
                          1
                        )
            END 
        ELSE 
            BEGIN 

                INSERT  INTO tbl_InspectionAttachment
                        ( InspectionId ,
                          InstallationType ,
                          DocumentID ,
                          DocumentName ,
                          fileName ,
                          DocumentPath ,
                          CreatedDate ,
                          CreatedBy ,
                          Status
                        )
                VALUES  ( @InspectionId ,
                          @InstallationType ,
                          @DocumentID ,
                          @DocSaveName ,
                          @FileName ,
                          @FilePath ,
                          GETDATE() ,
                          @CreatedBy ,
                          1
                        )
            END


       
    END



	go
